author: AJITH KUMAR MOHANAN
content:
I am using Android phone Lava with Android 4.4.2 version. Last year I have installed Google Handwriting Input very 1.6.1 and was using Malayalam handwriting without any problems. Last week I have upgraded the software to very 1.7.1. Now the Malayalam handwriting language is not getting downloaded. It says"error in downloading language".
I have done troubleshooting as per Google support page.
My question how I can get the Malayalam handwriting APK file direct download?

author: Swapnil Jha
content: You can't specifically download Malayalam Handwriting apk. You can try downloading Google Handwriting Input v1.6.1 from the internet or wait for future updates so that your problem gets fixed.
